visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D animated illustration of a bowl of ramen against a dark red background. The bowl contains yellow noodles, green onions, bamboo shoots, a soft-boiled egg cut in half, seaweed, and two slices of chashu. A circular icon representing the five senses (eye, ear, nose, mouth, hand) is superimposed in the center. A small cartoon boy logo is in the top left corner. (2) The background changes to a vibrant yellow with radial light beams. The ramen bowl is shown in the center with white wavy lines of steam rising. (3) The camera zooms in on a close-up of a slice of chashu pork being held by silver chopsticks. The meat has detailed fat marbling. Steam continues to drift upwards. (4) The scene returns to the full bowl of ramen against the yellow background. (5) The background transitions to solid purple. A title appears at the top center. The five-senses icon is displayed larger in the middle. At the bottom, a white rectangular box with a rounded border appears, containing a numbered list item and text.

(6) [Subtitle]: 輕輕一咬就化開，肉香四溢. (7) [Subtitle]: 和麵搭著吃簡直. (8) [Subtitle]: 讓人每一口都停不下來. (9) [Subtitle]: 這樣形容下來. (10) [Subtitle]: 是不是隔著螢幕都覺得超想吃呢. (11) [Subtitle]: 然而說話空洞其實. [Slogan]: 如何解決：形容詞空洞. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on how to improve their descriptive writing and speaking skills. It uses a vivid, sensory-rich description of ramen as a hook to demonstrate what effective communication looks like, then identifies the problem of 'empty adjectives' and provides a specific tip on using concrete numbers or situational descriptions.
